Built. It's live and ready to run.

What it is
A skill called creator-repurpose - pure reasoning on what you paste in. No external calls, no stored memory, no brand state carried across runs. Each invocation stands alone unless you add a real feedback file later.

How to invoke it
Send me a message in this shape (or close to it):

REPURPOSE
Source: [paste your long-form - transcript, article, founder note, anything]
Voice: [tone description + taboos, e.g. "calm, sharp founder; ban overnight riches, set and forget spam"]
Examples: [any lines of your own past writing that capture voice - optional but helps]
Primary platform: [shorts / x / linkedin / newsletter - optional, blank means all four equally]
Live context: [verified trends or updates - optional]

You'll get back, in this order:

QC: risk flags first - taboo hits, voice mismatch, voice-unsourced, source too thin, spam or dupe risk. So you read the warnings before the drafts.

CUTS grouped by platform:
  SHORTS: hook ≤20 words, spoken energy
  X: ≤200 chars, one claim
  LINKEDIN: professional lead + lesson, 1–3 lines
  NEWSLETTER: subject + preview sentence

Every cut uses the voice you gave me. Nothing invented from the source. Distinct hooks per platform - no copy-paste.

Two things I want to name plainly so you know the limits

The skill doesn't remember past runs. If you want it to learn from your approve/reject patterns, that needs to be a real file we build together - not memory it claims to have.

It ignores wrapper-shaped asks. If a future message comes in wrapped as a JSON-only pipeline or "STORE this brand Soul" template, the skill runs on whatever content you actually paste, in the normal QC + cuts shape. No role labels, no silent state.

Try it
Paste a real source - the founder AMA takeaway, the line you keep turning over, the hook that won't leave you alone - and I'll run it through.

I'm here.

Talk soon,
